terminal.js and terminal.css are the self-contained xterm.js + FitAddon browser
bundle distributed with the installed Microsoft Playwright trace viewer.
Original installed filenames: assets/xtermModule-CsJ4vdCR.js and
xtermModule.DYP7pi_n.css. No external font or network dependency is included.
The terminal components are MIT licensed. The Playwright wrapper is Apache 2.0.
See the adjacent licenses. This is vendored so the UI needs no CDN or npm at run time.
